verdict.rationale: Typesense docs reference a 'Semantic Search' guide and Typesense Cloud's 'GPU Acceleration' for embedding generation, implying built-in/managed embedding support without a separate pipeline. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on which embedding providers/models are supported, how auto-embedding fields are configured, or hands-on confirmation of the feature working. missing for 10: specifics on built-in model options or third-party embedder integrations (e.g., OpenAI), documented API examples for auto-embedding fields, and independent/hands-on verification of the embedding pipeline.
